verdict.rationale: Oyster is a global employment/HR SaaS platform, so operating it through natural-language commands is a fair axis, but the evidence pack documents no first-party assistant, chat interface or natural-language command capability. The published llms.txt and REST API are developer building blocks that an external agent could consume, not the product itself accepting natural-language commands, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
